:::{#exm-agent-only-rate}
#### Agent-only rate for the COVID-19 test

For the agreement table of @exm-agreement-table-covid,
the agent-only rate (@def-agent-only-rate) is:

$$
\ba
p_{\text{agent}}
&= \frac{93}{10{,}000}
&& \text{(definition of } p_{\text{agent}} \text{, with the table's counts)} \\
&= 0.0093
&& \text{(divide)}
\ea
$$

so the test flags about 9 people in 1,000 whom the reference calls negative.

:::
